purpose: Puts something away: the X in the corner of an alert, toast, dialog or tag. Use the inverse variant when it sits on an inverse surface such as a tooltip or snackbar.

notFor.case: A dismiss action that needs words, such as Cancel or Not now.
Any other icon-only action in a toolbar or row.
Removing one tag from a tag input.

Default.visual: soft takes Action/secondary/default with Content/on-secondary; outline a Border/control edge; ghost no fill and Content/secondary ink; inverse sits on Surface/inverse or Surface/inverse-muted with Content/inverse inks and a Border/inverse edge.

Hover.visual: Fill moves to Action/secondary/hover, or an Action/ghost/hover overlay (Surface/inverse-muted on inverse).

Pressed.visual: Fill moves to Action/secondary/pressed, or an Action/ghost/pressed overlay (Surface/inverse-muted on inverse).

Focused.visual: A halo outside the control (Border/subtle, Surface/inverse-muted on inverse); outline and ghost also take a Border/strong (Border/inverse) edge.

Disabled.visual: Action/disabled/default fill, Border/control edge, Content/disabled ink.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; Enter or Space activates it (native button).
notes: aria-label defaults to "Close"; the app should name what closes when the default is ambiguous.

openQuestions: Escape: should the parent (Dialog, Toast) always offer Escape as the keyboard twin of this button, or is that left to each parent?
